verdict.rationale: Mem0 is a memory-layer API/service for storing and retrieving facts for LLM agents; it does not offer a workflow/automation-scheduling capability where users configure tasks to run autonomously in the background. Webhooks (event notifications) are the closest feature but they are outbound notifications tied to memory CRUD events, not user-configured autonomous automations, so this axis is a category mismatch for the product type.
